chapters.title: The modules: Graph PowerShell and Exchange Online
Where to start as a beginner

takeaways: PowerShell turns clicks into reusable typed instructions, so a task done for fifty users takes one line and is done the same way every time.
Microsoft Graph PowerShell has replaced the retired Azure AD and MSOnline modules, with Exchange Online PowerShell handling mail, and both connect with only the scopes the job needs.
Start with read-only get commands, preview changes with the built-in safety switches, test on one account first and never store passwords in scripts.
hook: An hour of clicking in the Microsoft 365 admin center can do the job of one typed line, yet many admins avoid PowerShell because it looks intimidating. This Simply Explained episode is for beginners and busy admins who want to automate everyday tasks safely. You'll learn what modules, cmdlets and the pipeline are, how to connect with Microsoft Graph PowerShell and which habits keep your tenant safe.
